description: This file is a web UI page for configuring IPv6 firewall settings on a network device. It includes PHP code to retrieve current settings, HTML for the user interface, and JavaScript for interactivity and AJAX updates.

methods.name: setFirewall
methods.description: Sends an AJAX POST request to update the firewall configuration on the device and reloads the page upon success.

methods.name: keyboard_toggle
methods.description: Enables toggling of the custom security options via keyboard input.
